title: Implement Exit 137 Capture, Memory Slope and Task Quarantine
instructions: Append after the previous chunk without editing earlier lines. Implement recovery for 'Container OOM Crash': The container scheduler records an exit code of 137, captures memory slope, and quarantines the task to prevent cascading VM exhaustion. Read State.OOMKilled and ExitCode via docker inspect before removal; on exit 137 store the sampled docker stats memory series and its slope, and mark the task QUARANTINED so the scheduler never retries it automatically.
